pages.title: Pronghorn
pages.text: The pronghorn ($(o)Antilocapra americana$()) is a hoofed mammal of the open grasslands and deserts of western North America.$(br2)Although often called an antelope, it is the last surviving member of its own family, the Antilocapridae. Its forked horn sheaths are shed and regrown every year.$(br2)Pronghorn are the fastest land mammals in the Western Hemisphere, and can sustain high speeds over long distances.
